description: WebSocket session state machine accepts text payload frames during CONNECTING state before authentication verification.
spec_notes: WSSession.handle_frame must strictly require state == WSState.AUTHENTICATED for TEXT opcode.

repo_files.frames.py:
"""WebSocket frame representation."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Optional


@dataclass
class WSFrame:
    opcode: str  # "CONNECT", "AUTH", "TEXT", "PING", "PONG", "CLOSE"
    payload: str
    auth_token: Optional[str] = None
repo_files.fsm.py:
"""WebSocket connection protocol finite state machine."""

class WSState:
    DISCONNECTED = "DISCONNECTED"
    CONNECTING = "CONNECTING"
    AUTHENTICATED = "AUTHENTICATED"
    CLOSING = "CLOSING"
    CLOSED = "CLOSED"

tests.test_websocket_fsm.py:
from frames import WSFrame
from fsm import WSState
from session import WSSession
from connection_pool import WSPool


def test_valid_handshake_and_auth_flow():
    sess = WSSession("s1")
    assert sess.handle_frame(WSFrame("CONNECT", "")) is True
    assert sess.state == WSState.CONNECTING
    assert sess.handle_frame(WSFrame("AUTH", "", auth_token="valid_token")) is True
    assert sess.state == WSState.AUTHENTICATED
    assert sess.handle_frame(WSFrame("TEXT", "hello world")) is True
    assert sess.messages_received == ["hello world"]


def test_unauthenticated_text_frame_rejected():
    sess = WSSession("s2")
    sess.handle_frame(WSFrame("CONNECT", ""))
    # Attempting to send TEXT frame while in CONNECTING state must be rejected
    assert sess.handle_frame(WSFrame("TEXT", "unauthorized message")) is False
    assert len(sess.messages_received) == 0


def test_invalid_auth_token_stays_unauthenticated():
    sess = WSSession("s3")
    sess.handle_frame(WSFrame("CONNECT", ""))
    assert sess.handle_frame(WSFrame("AUTH", "", auth_token="bad_token")) is False
    assert sess.state == WSState.CONNECTING
    assert sess.handle_frame(WSFrame("TEXT", "payload")) is False


def test_close_transition():
    sess = WSSession("s4")
    sess.handle_frame(WSFrame("CONNECT", ""))
    sess.handle_frame(WSFrame("AUTH", "", auth_token="valid_token"))
    assert sess.handle_frame(WSFrame("CLOSE", "")) is True
    assert sess.state == WSState.CLOSED
    assert sess.handle_frame(WSFrame("TEXT", "post-close")) is False


def test_pool_authenticated_count():
    pool = WSPool()
    s1 = pool.create_session("u1")
    s2 = pool.create_session("u2")
    s1.handle_frame(WSFrame("CONNECT", ""))
    s1.handle_frame(WSFrame("AUTH", "", auth_token="valid_token"))
    s2.handle_frame(WSFrame("CONNECT", ""))
    assert pool.get_authenticated_count() == 1
